service.description: What reloading the conf files would change: the conf merged again (the default conf, each component's MoquiConf.xml in load order, the runtime conf on top) and compared with the running conf. Each change has its class (live: read on each use; apply: state built again; restart: read once at boot) and the outcome it would have. Nothing changes.

Reload the conf files: what can be live is put in the running conf and its state built again (screen mounts, token routes, web protection rules, new caches, new properties); what needs a restart is kept out of the running conf and listed as pending. The server does the same on SIGHUP.
The conf changes the last reload left waiting for a restart.
The components found in the component directories, as boot finds them, that are not loaded: one placed by ./moq component-get or a git clone since the start.

What loading a component on the running server would do, changing nothing: why it cannot be loaded now (a dependency not loaded, Rust code, a file that does not parse, an entity change the table check cannot make, a cluster), the conf changes its MoquiConf.xml makes with their class, its entities, and its data files by the type they declare.

Load a component on the running server: its tables made, then the component registered, the conf merged again and what can be live applied, its services, ECA rules, REST APIs, screens and skills reloaded, and its data loaded, each file on its own. With mode restart it is recorded and the next start loads it and its data.

parameter.name: dataTypes
parameter.description: The data types to load: seed, seed-initial and install when empty.

service.description: Leave out at the next start a component a deploy loaded: its directory is moved to .removed/ beside it. What it loaded stays until the restart; its tables and data stay after.

Fetch a branch of a git URL (https or ssh) into a repository kept as storage (database: a db GitRepository; bare: a remote GitRepository mirror on disk; clone: a working clone, by the git command, in a component directory), write its files to .staging-name beside where they go, and answer what deploying would do, as preview#ComponentLoad does. Needs the sealed COMPONENT_DEPLOY permission, and on a production instance component_deploy_enabled=true.

parameter.name: directory
parameter.description: For a clone: the component directory, component when empty.

service.description: Move the files preview#ComponentDeploy staged into place and load the component, as load#Component does. A load that fails puts the files back where they were staged.
Drop what preview#ComponentDeploy staged: its files and its row.

Fetch the branch of a component deployed from git and answer what updating it would do: the commits, the paths that changed, its conf changes, and why it cannot be updated now (a clone with changes of its own, or diverged from the branch).

Update a component deployed from git to its branch's head: the new files in place (the old ones kept in .previous/) or the clone fast-forwarded, its entities relinked when an entity file changed, the conf applied when its MoquiConf.xml changed, the changed files reloaded, and its changed data files of dataTypes loaded (seed when empty).
